result.description:
Full-time Painter and Decorator position available with competitive salary. Work with an established construction services company in Thornleigh,2120, NSW. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Painter and Decorator
•	$85.000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Apply your trade across residential and commercial construction projects

Position Overview:
Zencol – We are seeking an experienced and reliable Painter and Decorator to join our construction services team. The successful candidate will be responsible for applying paint, varnish, wallpaper and other finishes to protect, maintain and decorate the surfaces of buildings and structures on our residential and commercial projects.

This role is pivotal to delivering high-quality finishes across our projects. As Painter and Decorator, you will prepare surfaces, apply a range of finishes, and ensure all work is completed to a professional standard, on time and to specification.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

Site Preparation and Safety:

?	Erect scaffolding and ladders, and place drop sheets to protect adjacent areas from paint splattering.
?	Ensure all work is carried out safely and in compliance with relevant workplace health and safety requirements.

Surface Preparation:

?	Prepare surfaces by removing old paint and wallpaper, fixing woodwork, filling holes and cracks, and smoothing and sealing surfaces.
?	Select and prepare paints to required colours by mixing portions of pigment, oil, and thinning and drying additives.

Application of Finishes:

?	Apply paints, varnishes and stains to surfaces using brushes, rollers and sprays.
?	Hang wallpaper, matching patterns and trimming edges.
?	Clean equipment and work areas on completion of each job.

Additional Trade Tasks:

?	Repair windows and replace glass in wooden and metal frames, as required.
?	Lay and repair wall and floor tiles, as required.

Compliance and Industry Standards:

?	Ensure all work complies with relevant legislation, building codes, and workplace safety standards.
?	Stay informed of best practice and industry standards relevant to the painting and decorating trade.

Qualifications and Skills:

?	AQF Certificate III (including at least two years of on-the-job training) or AQF Certificate IV, or equivalent overseas qualification.
?	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification listed above.
?	Relevant registration or licensing, where required.
?	Proven experience as a Painter and Decorator within residential and/or commercial construction.
?	Strong attention to detail and a high standard of workmanship.
?	Ability to work safely at heights and use scaffolding and ladders.
?	Good communication skills and ability to work well within a team.
?	Reliable, punctual, and capable of working under pressure to meet deadlines.

Benefits:

?	Competitive salary.
?	Employee mentoring program.
?	Professional development assistance.
?	Referral program.
?	Visa sponsorship.
?	Work in a supportive team culture with an established construction services company.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package of $85.000 p.a. plus superannuation, full-time, Monday to Friday, day shift.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Baker for our client in Lavington, New South Wales. This role is responsible for preparing, baking, and finishing baked goods such as bread, rolls, pastries, and other baked products while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to food safety standards.

Job Description

Product

•	Weighing up and mixing as per recipe requirements.

•	Hand shaping and molding as instructed by Bakery Manager.

•	Maintaining quality and consistency standards.

•	Producing bread quantities in an efficient and timely manner to meet production forecast set by Bakery Manager.

Operations

•	Compliance with all workplace OH&S Laws.

•	Compliance with all Food Safety Standards.

•	Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness.

•	Report required equipment and kitchen maintenance.

•	Complete all daily, weekly and monthly FSP tasks as required.

Leadership

•	Maintaining a positive work culture and a 'Can Do' attitude.

•	Supporting fellow team members to achieve common goals.

•	Supervise Apprentice and Baker's Assistant as well as providing training to them.

•	Participate in baking workshops, forums and competitions when required.

Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Certificate III in Baking including at least two (2) years of on-the-job training, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•	Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Baker or in a similar commercial bakery role.

•	Demonstrated ability to produce baked goods to consistent quality and weight standards.

•	Strong knowledge of food safety standards and OH&S requirements in a bakery environment.

•	Ability to work efficiently and meet daily production targets within rostered hours.

•	Strong teamwork and communication skills with the ability to support and lead junior staff.

Salary

$75,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Chef for our client, a Thai restaurant in South Yarra, Victoria. As Chef, you will lead the kitchen in preparing authentic Thai cuisine, from crafting flavoursome curries and stir-fries to overseeing food quality, menu planning and kitchen operations. If you are passionate about Thai cooking and ready to showcase your skills in a vibrant, fast-paced restaurant in one of Melbourne's most exciting dining precincts, we would love to hear from you – apply today!
 
Job Description

• Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering food supplies for the restaurant.

• Preparing and cooking authentic Thai dishes to a consistently high standard, including curries, stir-fries, noodle and rice dishes.

• Monitoring the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation.

• Discussing food preparation issues with managers, dietitians, and kitchen and waiting staff.

• Demonstrating techniques and advising on cooking procedures to kitchen staff.

• Supervising and coordinating the activities of cooks and kitchen assistants during service.

• Ensuring the freshness and quality of ingredients, including sourcing authentic Thai produce and specialty items.

• Explaining and enforcing hygiene and food safety regulations in accordance with relevant legislation.

• Maintaining a clean, safe and organised kitchen environment, including the storage and maintenance of equipment.

• Assisting with stock control, portion control and minimising wastage to manage kitchen costs.
 
Qualifications / Attributes

• Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery, or at least 3 years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• At least 3 years of relevant work experience.

• Proven expertise in the kitchen, with strong all-round cooking skills and sound knowledge of Thai cuisine and cooking techniques.

• Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced kitchen environment while maintaining consistency and quality.

• Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene and WHS standards and practices.

• Excellent organisational and time management skills, including menu planning, stock control and cost management.

• Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to supervise and work collaboratively with kitchen staff.
 
Salary

$75,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

About the company

Zimmermann Industries is a leading Australian signage, branding and corporate identity specialist, established in 2007. The company delivers end-to-end solutions, managing every stage from concept and design through to fabrication, installation and maintenance. With strong foundations in traditional signwriting and advanced expertise in custom architectural, electronic and retail signage, Zimmermann Industries helps businesses maximise brand visibility and create lasting impressions. Known for innovation, quality craftsmanship and reliable service, the company has successfully delivered outstanding projects across diverse industries.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and grow our industrial signage, branding, and fabrication solutions. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, preparing quotations, conducting product presentations, and achieving sales targets. You will work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach to business development, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service while driving revenue growth and market expansion.

About the position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of Work: 9 Trade Place, Lilydale, Vic -3140

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Technical Assessment & Client Consultation: Review client concepts and architectural plans to assess technical needs, recommending the most suitable industrial fabrication methods, materials, and services to achieve the desired outcome. 
•	Commercial Quoting & Estimating: Scope out the true technical costs of manufacturing bespoke products on the factory floor. Prepare, quote, and negotiate accurate pricing for high-end retail and commercial signage projects. 
•	Technical Translation: Act as the technical liaison for the sales team, updating knowledge of our manufacturing capabilities, materials, and competitors' offerings to ensure our quoted solutions are highly marketable and viable. 
•	Production & Logistics Coordination: Factor in the complete lifecycle of the product during the estimating phase, arranging and quoting the delivery of goods, site logistics, and the provision of installation services. 
•	Reporting & Workflow Integration: Prepare detailed estimating reports for operations and sales management to ensure accurate project handovers. Follow up with the production team and clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve any technical problems arising during the build. 
Qualification and Skills
•	Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honors) or a higher degree in a highly relevant technical discipline (e.g., Engineering, Industrial Design). 
•	A Minimum of 1 year of relevant professional B2B experience in sales of industrial design, retail store design, or technical fabrication. 
•	Technical Proficiency: High-level understanding of industrial manufacturing processes, CAD, and how complex concepts are physically built on a factory floor. 
•	Commercial Acumen: Strong foundation skills in product costing, with a willingness to be mentored in the commercial, quoting, and negotiating aspects of the business. 

Interested in the role? Apply for the role if you think you meet the criteria, and we’ll get in contact with you shortly. Only eligible candidates will be contacted.

About the role
Melbourne Automotive Engineering has been delivering trusted repairs, diagnostics, and tuning from our Bundoora workshop to Melbourne drivers and major insurers alike. With a scope that covers everything from routine servicing through to complete engine rebuilds, we are now looking for an experienced Mechanic to join our team. This is a hands-on trade role for someone who takes their work seriously and holds themselves to a high standard on every job, regardless of what comes through the door.

Key responsibilities
- Work across a steady mix of servicing and repair jobs, managing your own time and keeping jobs moving without sacrificing the standard of work
- Diagnose problems properly, using both hands-on knowledge and electronic diagnostic equipment to find the actual fault before touching anything
- Carry out repairs and mechanical rebuilds accurately, using manufacturer documentation as the benchmark and verifying your work before anything goes back to the customer
- Handle routine maintenance with the same attention as the bigger jobs, because preventative work done well keeps customers off the lift longer
- Assess vehicles for roadworthiness and prepare accurate reports or certificates where your qualifications allow

About you
- Trade-qualified mechanic (or with relevant experience) with genuine workshop experience and the diagnostic ability to back it up
- Someone who takes pride in their work and doesn't cut corners when rebuilding or reassembling
- Comfortable with computerised diagnostic tools and able to interpret what they're telling you
- Organised and self-directed, able to move between jobs without losing focus on quality
- Current driver's licence essential

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Drive growth. Build trusted clinical partnerships. Shape the future of private healthcare.

St Vincent's Private Hospital Toowoomba is seeking an accomplished Business Development Manager to lead specialist engagement, doctor recruitment and strategic growth initiatives across one of Queensland's most respected private hospitals.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a seasoned relationship-builder who thrives in complex stakeholder environments and can confidently engage with specialists, practice managers, GPs and senior health leaders.

Reporting to the State Business Development Manager and working closely with the General Manager, you will play a critical role in growth key specialty services, strengthening referral pathways and supporting the recruitment and retention of Visiting Medical Officers (VMOs).

If you're commercially astute, highly credible and passionate about building long-term partnerships that deliver sustainable growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

As Business Development Manager, you will:

Drive specialty growth strategies aligned to the hospital's strategic priorities

Develop and maintain trusted relationships with specialist doctors, VMOs, practice managers and referring GPs

Identify, recruit and onboard new specialists to support service growth.

Analyse market opportunities, referral patterns and business performance data to identity growth opportunities

Contribute to the development of business cases and strategic growth initiatives that deliver measurable outcomes

Lead doctor engagement activities, education events, and referral development programs

Partner with hospital leadership and marketing teams to execute business development and marketing strategies

Maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities through CRM and business intelligence reporting

About you:

You are an experienced commercial professional with a proven ability to build credibility in specialist healthcare environments.

You will ideally bring:

Significant experience in healthcare business development, clinical network development, healthcare sales or hospital engagement.

A demonstrated track record of influencing and building relationships with specialists, surgeons, physicians and referrers.

Strong communication acumen with experience developing business cases and growth strategies.

Exceptional stakeholder management, presentation and negotiation skills.

Experience working autonomously while partnering effectively with executive leaders.

A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to execution.

Experience within private hospitals, healthcare services or specialist healthcare networks will be highly regarded.

Qualifications in Business, Commerce, Health or a related discipline are desirable.

Why join St Vincent's Health Australia?

Make a genuine impact within Australia's largest for purpose health and aged care provider.

Work alongside highly respected clinical and executive leaders.

Competitive salary and salary packaging benefits.

Up to $15,990 salary packaging plus Meals and Entertainment benefits.

Private health insurance discounts through Medibank and Bupa.

Additional leave purchase options.

Access to Fitness Passport and Employee Assistance Program.

Blue Light Card discounts across hundreds of retailers.

About St Vincent's Private Hospital Toowoomba

St Vincent's Private Hospital Toowoomba is the largest acute private hospital on the Darling Downs, delivering exceptional care across more than 30 specialties including surgical, cardiac, cancer, maternity, emergency and medical services. 

As part of St Vincent's Health Australia, we are driven by our values of Compassion, Excellence, Integrity and Justice, and are committed to delivering outstanding patient-centred care to our community. 

Mission and Values:

As both a provider of care and as an employer, St Vincent's aspires to create an environment that is truly inclusive for all people, always. St Vincent's is constantly striving for inclusivity and to create and cherish a diverse place of care and work.

The Client
Melbourne Earthescapes Pty Ltd is a family-owned earthmoving, landscaping, and construction business based in Ravenhall, VIC, delivering landscaping, retaining wall construction, rockwork, stone installation, and transportation services across Melbourne and surrounding regions. 

They are seeking an experienced Stonemason to join their team in Ravenhall, VIC.

The Role
The Stonemason is responsible for constructing, repairing, and installing stone structures, retaining walls, masonry features, and related stonework in accordance with project specifications and construction requirements.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Cut and shape hard and soft stone blocks and masonry slabs to construct and renovate stone structures, kitchen benchtops, and monumental masonry
•	Lay pre-cut stones and masonry blocks in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches, and structural stone features
•	Study plans and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and installation procedures
•	Erect and dismantle restricted height scaffolding in accordance with workplace safety procedures
•	Seal foundations with damp-resistant materials and apply mortar layers to support masonry installation works
•	Lay stones in rows, designs, and patterns while maintaining structural alignment and finish quality
•	Embed stone blocks in mortar and remove excess material to achieve clean and accurate finishes
•	Check vertical and horizontal alignment of stone structures using levelling and measuring equipment
•	Cut, shape, polish, and finish stone materials using hand tools, polishing equipment, and masonry machinery
•	Repair and maintain stone, brick, and masonry structures in accordance with construction requirements
•	Design, cut, and install monumental masonry and stone lettering works
•	Construct retaining walls, stone facades, and structural masonry installations for residential and commercial projects Choose and prepare appropriate metal materials for fabrication

The Requirements
•	Certificate III in Stonemasonry, Bricklaying, Construction, or equivalent trade qualification
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Stonemason within construction, landscaping, or masonry environments
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and construction measurements for masonry works
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing retaining walls, stone structures, and masonry installations across residential or commercial projects
•	At least 5 years’ experience operating masonry tools, polishing equipment, cutting machinery, and stone fabrication tools
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing stone retaining walls, rock walls, garden walls, paving, steps and outdoor stone features
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience using stone cutting, grinding, drilling, shaping and finishing tools in a construction or landscaping environment
•	Strong knowledge of masonry construction methods, mortar application, and stone finishing techniques
•	Ability to read and interpret technical plans, site measurements, and installation specifications accurately
•	Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, scaffolding requirements, and construction compliance standards
•	White Card required
•	Excavator and Skid Steer licences preferred
•	Ability to work outdoors, at heights, and across varying construction site environments
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and ability to work independently or within construction teams
•	High attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality

About the Position
This position supports the practical implementation of horticultural production programs, including land preparation, operating programs, production inputs, machinery use, irrigation, crop protection and harvesting activities.
Occupation Tasks
*	Ensure all land preparations are completed in accordance with established procedures.
*	Train and monitor operators where required to ensure tasks are completed in line with standard operating procedures.
*	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly work programs to facilitate implementation of required production tasks.
*	Assess the quality of work and take corrective action where applicable.
*	Ensure all material inputs are adequate for the relevant operations.
*	Ensure the upkeep of tractors and implements used in production operations.
*	Liaise with the Farm Operations Manager, Agronomist and Maintenance Manager where required.
*	Operate tractors and implements required for horticultural production.
*	Identify and report unusual disease or plant pest signs.
*	Operate pressurised irrigation systems.
*	Prepare and apply chemicals to control pests, weeds and diseases in accordance with approved procedures.
*	Coordinate horticultural crop harvesting.
*	Fumigate soil where required and authorised.
*	Manage and install drainage systems.
*	Monitor and manage nursery plants.
*	Operate spreading and seeding equipment.
*	Hand planting seeds (crop specific)
*	Machine planting seed/transplants (crop specific)
*	Operate harvesting tractor and over-see 6 staff
*	Installation of drip Irrigation
*	Removal of drip Irrigation
*	Irrigation testing/maintenance
*	Crop monitoring
*	Record keeping- harvesting and planting records for Organic Certification Audits
*	Training of any new staff

Skills, Experience, Qualifications
*	Relevant AQF Certificate III or Certificate IV qualifications or
*	Equivalent; or 3 years employment experience as a production horticulturalist with relevant formal training; or
*	5 years employment experience as a production horticulturalist with no formal training.

Market Salary 	$75,000- $80,000 per annum plus superannuation
